article_title: The Â£70 refund letter that isn't a scam

tasks.prompt: What is the article mainly about?
options: Why some low earners will receive a genuine HMRC pension top-up letter and how they can verify it
Why everyone in the UK must pay £70 to HMRC
How to choose a private pension provider
Why HMRC has stopped communicating by post
tasks.correct_answer: Why some low earners will receive a genuine HMRC pension top-up letter and how they can verify it
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה מסבירה מדוע חלק מבעלי ההכנסה הנמוכה יקבלו מכתב אמיתי על השלמת פנסיה וכיצד לבדוק שאינו הונאה.

tasks.prompt: Why did some low earners receive less pension tax relief than others?
options: They chose not to save for retirement
Their employers used Net Pay Arrangement schemes rather than Relief at Source schemes
They earned more than every higher-rate taxpayer
They refused to give HMRC a phone number
tasks.correct_answer: Their employers used Net Pay Arrangement schemes rather than Relief at Source schemes
tasks.explanation_hebrew: סוג הסדר הפנסיה שקבע המעסיק גרם לכך שחלק מבעלי ההכנסה הנמוכה קיבלו פחות הטבת מס, ללא שליטה שלהם בבחירה.

tasks.prompt: How much will an eligible person typically receive?
options: Exactly £12,570
About £70, although the amount can vary
A fixed £1,000 every month
Only a social-media voucher
tasks.correct_answer: About £70, although the amount can vary
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הסכום הטיפוסי הוא כ־70 ליש״ט, אך הוא עשוי להשתנות במידה ניכרת לפי נסיבות האדם.

tasks.prompt: Why does the article stress that HMRC will not text, email or call about this payment?
options: HMRC no longer has internet access
It helps recipients distinguish official contact from scam messages
The payment is available only outside the UK
A telephone call would reduce the payment
tasks.correct_answer: It helps recipients distinguish official contact from scam messages
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הדגשת ערוצי הקשר נועדה לעזור לזהות מתחזים: פנייה בנושא בהודעה, בדוא״ל או בטלפון היא הונאה.

tasks.prompt: What does “hoodwinked” mean in the article?
options: Paid automatically
Tricked or deceived
Registered for a pension
Contacted by letter
tasks.explanation_hebrew: hoodwinked פירושו מרומה או מוטעה בידי אדם אחר, למשל נוכל המתחזה ל־HMRC.

tasks.prompt: What does “non take-up” mean in Sir Steve Webb's warning?
options: Eligible people failing to claim or receive the payment
HMRC sending too many letters
Employers changing every pension scheme
People earning above the tax threshold
tasks.correct_answer: Eligible people failing to claim or receive the payment
tasks.explanation_hebrew: non take-up הוא מצב שבו אנשים זכאים אינם משלימים את התהליך ולכן אינם מקבלים את הכסף המגיע להם.

tasks.prompt: Explain who is eligible for the top-up and why the government created it.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין את רמת ההכנסה, סוג הסדר הפנסיה, חוסר השליטה של העובד ומטרת התיקון.
expected_points: The recipients are low earners, mostly women
They typically earned close to but not more than £12,570 a year
Their employer used a Net Pay Arrangement pension scheme
Comparable workers in Relief at Source schemes received more tax relief
Employees could not choose which scheme their employer used
The government created the low earner's pension payment to top up those who missed out
Initial payments cover the 2024-25 tax year
Later years are intended to be handled automatically

tasks.prompt: Why might many eligible people fail to receive the payment even though HMRC contacts them automatically?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר לפחות שלושה חסמים אפשריים המוזכרים או משתמעים ישירות מן הכתבה.
expected_points: Unexpected financial letters may look like scams
People may be cautious and ignore genuine contact
HMRC may not have a recipient's current address
Recipients must provide bank details through an official process
Some people are digitally excluded
The government budget assumes much lower participation than full take-up
Clear communication and public awareness are therefore important

tasks.prompt: Summarise the payment scheme and the steps a recipient can use to verify and receive it safely.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לכלול את סיבת התשלום, הסכום הטיפוסי, דרך הפנייה, סימני ההונאה וערוצי האימות הרשמיים.
expected_points: The scheme corrects unequal pension tax relief for some low earners
About one million people may receive letters
The typical payment is £70 but amounts vary
HMRC contacts eligible people automatically by letter or personal tax account
HMRC will not text, email or call about the payment
It will not ask for transfers, PINs or passwords
Recipients can verify the letter on Gov.uk under Low Earner's Pension Payment
Bank details should be provided only through the official personal tax account
Digitally excluded customers can phone HMRC
Recipients should ensure HMRC has their latest address

tasks.prompt: Write a short public notice explaining how to recognise the genuine payment without creating unnecessary fear.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לכתוב באנגלית בטון ברור ומרגיע, לכלול לפחות ארבעה סימני אימות ולא לבקש פרטים אישיים.
expected_points: Identify the Low Earner's Pension Payment
State that HMRC will contact eligible people automatically
Mention the typical £70 amount can vary
Say genuine contact comes by letter or personal tax account
Warn that texts, emails or calls about this payment are scams
State that HMRC never asks for a money transfer, PIN or password
Direct readers to verify on Gov.uk or through official HMRC channels
Mention the official personal tax account for bank details
Do not include invented links or request personal information
